hybrid_cloud_model.description: Pins one cloud model for every cloud step (e.g. gemini-3.5-flash-lite). Empty: the person's cloud tier choice.

hybrid_on_device_max_chars.description: Default on-phone limit: requests longer than this go to the cloud. The person's own setting wins.

hybrid_default_mode.description: Default routing for new installs: PREFER_ON_DEVICE, PREFER_IN_CLOUD or ONLY_ON_DEVICE.

hybrid_cloud_enabled.description: false switches the cloud off for everyone (Gemini Nano only), e.g. when the shared free quota runs out.

hybrid_limited_use_app_check_tokens.description: App Check limited-use tokens on every cloud call (replay protection). false turns them off.

hybrid_nano_note.description: Extra instructions added to Gemini Nano's prompt for every request, after the built-in JavaScript note (up to 1,500 characters). Empty adds nothing.

hybrid_python_note.description: The Python helper's note to Gemini Nano. Empty: the built-in note (core/PyHelper.kt NOTE).

hybrid_python_examples.description: Worked examples added after the Python helper's note (for example a correct edit_lines call). Empty adds nothing.

hybrid_python_helper_default.description: Whether the Python helper for Gemini Nano is on for people who have not set it in Settings > Assistant.

hybrid_python_outline_lines.description: Python files longer than this many lines are shown to Gemini Nano as an outline with the relevant function (50 to 5000).

hybrid_nano_temperature.description: Gemini Nano's temperature for people who have not saved their own (0 to 2).

hybrid_nano_top_k.description: Gemini Nano's top-K for people who have not saved their own (1 to 100).

hybrid_nano_max_output_tokens.description: Gemini Nano's longest reply, in tokens, for people who have not saved their own (64 to 8192).

hybrid_nano_full_model.description: true: the Full on-phone model (Gemma 4 E4B) instead of Fast (E2B) for people who have not chosen.

hybrid_cloud_tier_default.description: The cloud tier for people who have not picked one: auto, fast, balanced or best.

hybrid_handoff_after_failures.description: Failed tool calls in a row before Gemini Nano hands the rest of a request to the cloud (1 to 10).

hybrid_quota_waits.description: Times a cloud step waits out a per-minute quota limit before the cloud counts as out (0 to 10).

hybrid_busy_wait_ms.description: How long a step waits, once, when every cloud tier is busy (0 to 60000 ms).

hybrid_cloud_out_minutes.description: How long the cloud counts as out after a quota limit that is not daily (1 to 1440 minutes).

hybrid_nano_reread_reshows.description: Times Gemini Nano is shown a file again when it rereads it with no cloud to hand to (0 to 10).

hybrid_repair_broken_json.description: Read Gemini Nano's actions written in slightly broken JSON or YAML. false turns the repair off.

hybrid_nano_ask_again.description: In Private mode, ask Gemini Nano once more after a reply that is not an action. false turns it off.

hybrid_python_syntax_check.description: Check Python files parse before a write is kept (in PocketIDE's Linux). false turns the check off.

hybrid_page_wiring_check.description: Check pages load their script and that scripts look up ids the page has. false turns the check off.

hybrid_python_fix.description: Python fix path for Gemini Nano: the app finds the function, Nano rewrites it whole several times, and the request's test keeps the first rewrite that passes. false leaves Nano to its usual tools.

hybrid_python_fix_temperature.description: Temperature of the fix path's rewrites after the first (the first uses the person's own), 0-2.

hybrid_python_fix_cloud.description: When Gemini Nano's rewrites fail and the cloud is allowed (not Private mode, online, quota left), the cloud model is shown the block, the test and its failure and writes the fixed block; the test decides (two calls at most). false keeps the fix path on the phone.

hybrid_python_fix_cascade.description: Before the cloud writes the block itself, it says in a few lines what to change and Gemini Nano writes the code from that (one call). false skips this step.

hybrid_show_thoughts.description: Show the cloud model's thought summaries (tiers that think) and Gemini Nano's reasoning in the agent's thinking block, as for API models. false asks for no thought summaries and puts Nano's reasoning back in the reply.

hybrid_python_fix_rewrites.description: Rewrites the Python fix path tries for the first block it picks (half as many for each next one), 1-10. Replaces hybrid_python_fix_samples (no longer read).

hybrid_preview_cloud_per_hour.description: Cloud answers an hour for pages in PocketIDE's Preview that use the PocketIDEAI bridge (the Hybrid AI web app starter), 0-500. 0 = Gemini Nano only. Keeps apps built in PocketIDE from using up the project's free quota.
